subject: Aurelia Labs pilot: request for additional credits + commit discount
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@aurelialabs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: pilot extension + additional credits and discount

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for yesterday's walkthrough — the demo landed well with our ML and infra leads. We're close to an internal kickoff, but procurement surfaced two blockers they need solved before signing:

1) We budgeted for the 30-day trial, but the model evals will take longer. Can Redwood extend the pilot window to 90 days?
2) We need an uplift of free credits to cover experimentation (~$60k of credits) so our teams can run larger evaluation workloads.
3) If we commit to a 12-month minimum spend after the pilot, would Redwood offer a commercial discount (we were thinking ~20% off list for year one)?

I've attached our procurement timeline and the architecture notes procurement asked for. Realistically, procurement wants these items cleared this week to get to legal. Can you advise if there is an exec-level approval path for the combined ask (credits + discount)?

Appreciate any fast help — Claire

Attachments: Aurelia_Pilot_Timeline.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB); Aurelia_Procurement_Specs.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 90KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@aurelialabs.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pilot extension + additional credits and discount

Hi Claire,

Really glad the demo resonated. We're happy to work through procurement and support a longer evaluation — and we can propose a structure that meets your evaluation needs while protecting Redwood's economics. High-level proposal I can present to my leadership for approval:

- Pilot extension: 90 days total (starting on the kickoff date).
- Free credits: $60,000 in platform credits applied to the pilot environment.
- Commercial incentive: conditional 15% discount on list pricing for the first 12 months if Aurelia signs a committed monthly spend >= $15k/mo after the pilot. Discount applied only to the committed baseline.

This combined concession is above the standard approval threshold, so I'll need exec sign-off. If that structure is acceptable, I'll escalate today and loop in procurement/legal to get a Statement of Work + DocuSign ready.

One quick ask — can procurement confirm whether the 12-month commit is acceptable as a commercial condition? If so, I will push for approval with the conditions above.

I’ll follow up shortly after I speak with leadership.

Best,

Subject: Fwd: Aurelia Labs pilot — approval request for combined credits + discount (need exec OK)

Marissa / Ben / Aditya —

Looping you in: Aurelia Labs (AI-driven medical imaging analytics) is asking for a 90-day pilot extension, $60k of free credits for the pilot, and a 15% commercial discount on year-one if they commit to a 12-month minimum auto-renew at >= $15k/mo.

Why I recommend greenlight:
- Strategic fit: They are a referenceable healthcare customer with potential for rapid expansion across two product lines.
- Timeline: Procurement needs this cleared this week or they won't make next quarter's deployment window.
- Upside: Our forecast shows >$180k ARR if they convert at the commit level; the requested credits are primarily to cover burst experiments during model selection.

Economic ask: credits $60k one-time (pilot only) + 15% off list for first 12 months on committed baseline. On a pure margin analysis, this is ~13% NRR impact in year one vs. list.

Attachments: deal_summary_v1.xlsx (contains ARR scenarios and credit burn estimates)

I recommend approval with the following conditions:
1) Commit signed before credits issued; credits applied only to pilot namespace and expire at pilot end.
2) No stacking with other promotional offers.
3) Standard SOC2/PIA responses to be completed prior to production access.

Requesting a decision ASAP (T+24 hours ideally).

Thanks — Soojin

Subject: Re: Fwd: Aurelia Labs pilot — approval request for combined credits + discount

Soojin — quick thoughts:

I support approval but add two operational guardrails:
1) Credits capped at $60k but telemetry gating — we issue in 3 tranches (30k upfront, 15k at day 30 if milestones met, 15k at day 60). This prevents credit misuse.
2) Discount only on committed baseline (not on overage), and require monthly usage reporting for first 6 months.

If leadership agrees to tranche gating, we can say yes today and I will prepare the accounting treatment and the promo code workflow.

-Ben
Sales Ops

Ben recommends a tranche-based credit release and reporting. I recommend approval with the tranche approach and three additional conditions:

- Condition B: Signed commit (DocuSign executed) prior to the second tranche issuance.
- Condition C: Legal to sign off on a modest liability carveout (no SLA expansion).

Request: greenlight for the concession with the conditions above. If approved, Ops (Ben) will prepare the tranche flow and Soojin will coordinate docs with Aurelia procurement.
